eyebrow: The core measure — and why it's DISTINCTCOUNT
code:
Order Count = DISTINCTCOUNT ( fct_orders[order_id] )

-- NOT: COUNTROWS ( fct_orders )
-- a duplicate order_id row would silently inflate that count
caption: A deliberate safeguard, not a style choice — keep this one in mind.

code:
Orders Stuck =
CALCULATE (
    [Order Count],
    fct_orders[status] <> "completed",
    DATEDIFF ( fct_orders[order_date], TODAY(), DAY ) > 7
)
caption: A real tripwire Ops checks daily, not just a status breakdown.

subtitle: A real dbt gotcha: a join fanout
